<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>Heritage Quest — Mode 1</title>

<style>
* {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

:root {
    --gold: #e7b94f;
    --light-gold: #f6d878;
    --cream: #f5eddf;
    --dark: #080503;
    --brown: #211207;
    --green: #78c98a;
    --red: #d86f61;
}

html,
body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

body {
    overflow: hidden;

    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.74),
            rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.30),
            rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.52)
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            180deg,
            rgba(0,0,0,0.10),
            rgba(0,0,0,0.68)
        ),
        url("assets/konark.jpeg") center center / cover no-repeat;
}

/* =========================
   MAIN
========================= */

.game {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: 68px 1fr;
}

/* =========================
   TOP BAR
========================= */

.topbar {
    height: 68px;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    align-items: center;

    padding: 0 28px;

    background: rgba(5, 3, 2, 0.94);

    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.55);

    position: relative;
    z-index: 20;
}

.brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;

    color: var(--gold);

    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: bold;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.brand-symbol {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;

    border: 2px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 50%;

    display: grid;
    place-items: center;

    font-size: 16px;
}

.mode-title {
    text-align: center;

    padding: 7px 38px;

    min-width: 350px;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    background: rgba(13,8,3,0.95);

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    clip-path: polygon(
        7% 0,
        93% 0,
        100% 22%,
        100% 78%,
        93% 100%,
        7% 100%,
        0 78%,
        0 22%
    );
}

.mode-title small {
    display: block;

    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
}

.mode-title strong {
    font-size: 18px;
}

.top-actions {
    justify-self: end;

    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
}

.top-action {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;

    text-transform: uppercase;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        color 0.2s ease,
        transform 0.2s ease;
}

.top-action:hover {
    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* =========================
   CONTENT
========================= */

.content {
    min-height: 0;
    height: calc(100vh - 68px);
    overflow: hidden;

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        255px
        minmax(620px, 1fr)
        205px;

    gap: 20px;

    padding: 14px 28px 12px;
}

/* =========================
   LEFT
========================= */

 .left-panel {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;

    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: auto auto auto minmax(0, 1fr) 68px;
    gap: 8px;
}

.mode-label {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 23px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.main-heading {
    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 1.04;

    font-weight: normal;

    padding-bottom: 8px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.65);
}

.description {
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.4;

    color: var(--cream);
}

.description span {
    color: var(--light-gold);
}

.instruction-box {
    padding: 11px;

    background: rgba(12,7,3,0.78);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.68);
}

.instruction-title {
    text-align: center;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 17px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.instruction {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 10px;

    margin: 7px 0;

    color: #ddd0bb;

    font-size: 14px;
}

.instruction-number {
    width: 25px;
    height: 25px;

    flex-shrink: 0;

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius: 50%;

    display: grid;
    place-items: center;

    color: var(--gold);
}

/* =========================
   KONARK FACTS
========================= */

.facts-box {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 10px 13px;

    background: rgba(8,5,2,0.73);

    border-left: 2px solid var(--gold);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.28);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.28);
}

.facts-title {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 1.5px;

    margin-bottom: 7px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.fact {
    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 12px;

    line-height: 1.4;

    margin: 5px 0;
}

.fact::before {
    content: "◆";

    color: var(--gold);

    font-size: 7px;

    margin-right: 7px;
}

/* =========================
   SCORE
========================= */

.score-box {
    margin-top: 0;

    min-height: 68px;
    height: 68px;

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

    background: rgba(7,4,2,0.88);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.62);
}

.score-item {
    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;

    gap: 3px;
}

.score-item + .score-item {
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.38);
}

.score-label {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 11px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.score-value {
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: var(--light-gold);
}

/* =========================
   CENTER
========================= */

.center-panel {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;

    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    align-items: center;
}

.question-header {
    margin-bottom: 5px;

    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 13px;

    letter-spacing: 2px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.question-header strong {
    color: var(--light-gold);
}

/* =========================
   SOUND PLAYER
========================= */

.sound-panel {
    width: min(360px, 88%);

    padding: 8px 18px 9px;

    text-align: center;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(42,25,10,0.91),
            rgba(8,5,2,0.94)
        );

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.72);

    box-shadow:
        0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.40),
        inset 0 0 25px rgba(231,185,79,0.04);
}

.sound-title {
    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 14px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.sound-button {
    width: 54px;
    height: 54px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    border: 2px solid var(--gold);

    background: rgba(4,3,2,0.94);

    color: var(--gold);

    font-family: Georgia, serif;

    font-size: 22px;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: 0.2s ease;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 5px rgba(231,185,79,0.06),
        0 0 20px rgba(231,185,79,0.16);
}

.sound-button:hover {
    transform: scale(1.06);

    background: rgba(231,185,79,0.13);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 7px rgba(231,185,79,0.07),
        0 0 27px rgba(231,185,79,0.25);
}

.sound-button.playing {
    color: #f19a80;

    border-color: #d86f61;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 5px rgba(216,111,97,0.08),
        0 0 25px rgba(216,111,97,0.22);
}

.sound-status {
    margin-top: 5px;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 10px;

    letter-spacing: 1.4px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sound-question {
    margin-top: 4px;

    font-size: 18px;
}

/* =========================
   ANSWERS
========================= */

.answers-title {
    margin: 8px 0 6px;

    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 1.5px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.cards {
    width: 100%;

    flex: 1;

    min-height: 0;

    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(3, minmax(110px, 1fr));

    grid-template-rows:
        repeat(2, minmax(92px, 1fr));

    gap: 7px;
}

.card {
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;

    position: relative;

    overflow: hidden;

    background: rgba(8,5,2,0.83);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.56);

    cursor: pointer;

    transition:
        transform 0.2s ease,
        border-color 0.2s ease,
        box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);

    border-color: var(--light-gold);

    box-shadow:
        0 7px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
        0 0 15px rgba(231,185,79,0.15);
}

.card.selected {
    transform: translateY(-3px);

    border: 2px solid var(--light-gold);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 2px rgba(231,185,79,0.12),
        0 0 22px rgba(231,185,79,0.25);
}

.card.correct {
    border-color: var(--green);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 25px rgba(120,201,138,0.3);
}

.card.wrong {
    border-color: var(--red);

    animation: shake 0.28s ease;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 20px rgba(216,111,97,0.25);
}

@keyframes shake {
    0%, 100% {
        transform: translateX(0);
    }

    25% {
        transform: translateX(-5px);
    }

    75% {
        transform: translateX(5px);
    }
}

.card-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100% - 29px);

    object-fit: cover;

    display: block;

    opacity: 0.9;

    transition: 0.25s ease;
}

.card:hover .card-image {
    transform: scale(1.035);

    opacity: 1;
}

.card-name {
    position: absolute;

    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;

    height: 29px;

    display: flex;

    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;

    background: rgba(7,4,2,0.94);

    color: var(--cream);

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 0.7px;
}

.card.selected .card-name {
    color: var(--light-gold);
}

/* =========================
   SUBMIT
========================= */

.submit-row {
    margin-top: 5px;
}

.submit-button {
    min-width: 210px;

    padding: 7px 22px;

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            rgba(56,34,12,0.96),
            rgba(12,7,3,0.96)
        );

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-family: Georgia, serif;

    font-size: 13px;

    letter-spacing: 1.5px;

    text-transform: uppercase;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.submit-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: rgba(231,185,79,0.15);

    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.submit-button:disabled {
    opacity: 0.38;

    cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* =========================
   RIGHT
========================= */

.right-panel {
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 10px;
}

.progress-box {
    padding: 11px;

    text-align: center;

    background: rgba(10,6,3,0.79);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.65);
}

.progress-label {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 1.5px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.progress-percent {
    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 27px;
}

.progress-track {
    width: 100%;
    height: 9px;

    margin-top: 7px;

    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.45);
}

.progress-fill {
    width: 0%;
    height: 100%;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            #98631c,
            var(--light-gold)
        );

    transition: width 0.45s ease;
}

.progress-divider {
    height: 1px;

    margin: 14px 0;

    background: rgba(231,185,79,0.3);
}

.question-number-label {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.question-number {
    margin-top: 3px;

    font-size: 27px;
}

.tip-box {
    padding: 15px;

    background: rgba(8,5,2,0.72);

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.4);

    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 13px;

    line-height: 1.5;
}

.tip-box strong {
    display: block;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 11px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

/* =========================
   FEEDBACK
========================= */

.feedback {
    position: fixed;

    left: 50%;
    bottom: 22px;

    transform: translate(-50%, 90px);

    opacity: 0;

    z-index: 100;

    min-width: 280px;

    padding: 12px 22px;

    text-align: center;

    background: rgba(7,4,2,0.97);

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.feedback.show {
    transform: translate(-50%,0);

    opacity: 1;
}

.feedback.success {
    border-color: var(--green);
}

.feedback.error {
    border-color: var(--red);
}

/* =========================
   INFORMATION MODAL
========================= */

.modal {
    position: fixed;

    inset: 0;

    z-index: 300;

    display: none;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    padding: 25px;

    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.72);

    backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
}

.modal.show {
    display: flex;
}

.modal-box {
    width: min(500px, 94%);

    max-height: 88vh;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    padding: 18px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(42,25,10,0.98),
            rgba(8,5,2,0.98)
        );

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    box-shadow:
        0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.65);
}

.modal-title {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 25px;

    font-weight: normal;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    text-transform: uppercase;

    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.modal-text {
    color: #d8cbb5;

    font-size: 14px;

    line-height: 1.5;

    max-height: 27vh;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding-right: 6px;
}

.modal-text p {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.map-visual {
    display: none;
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding: 10px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(48, 29, 13, 0.98),
            rgba(9, 5, 2, 0.99)
        );

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.72);

    box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 28px rgba(231,185,79,0.045),
        0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.map-visual.show {
    display: block;
}

.map-heading {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    padding: 0 3px;

    color: var(--light-gold);
    font-size: 12px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.map-heading span {
    color: #b9a98d;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.map-frame {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;

    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.5);
    background: #24170b;

    box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.map-frame::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(34,19,7,0.20),
            rgba(246,216,120,0.035),
            rgba(34,19,7,0.25)
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            180deg,
            rgba(0,0,0,0.10),
            rgba(0,0,0,0.25)
        );

    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}

.map-frame img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: min(56vh, 410px);
    min-height: 260px;

    object-fit: contain;
    object-position: center;

    filter:
        saturate(0.72)
        contrast(0.95)
        brightness(0.76)
        sepia(0.14);

    opacity: 0.96;
}

.map-caption {
    position: absolute;
    left: 12px;
    bottom: 10px;
    z-index: 2;

    padding: 6px 10px;

    background: rgba(8,5,2,0.84);
    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.45);

    color: var(--light-gold);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.map-konark-marker {
    position: absolute;

    right: 22%;
    bottom: 33%;
    z-index: 3;

    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: var(--light-gold);
    border: 2px solid #2c1807;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 5px rgba(246,216,120,0.22),
        0 0 18px rgba(246,216,120,0.72);

    animation: mapKonarkPulse 1.8s infinite;
}

.map-konark-marker::after {
    content: "KONARK";

    position: absolute;
    left: 23px;
    top: -4px;

    white-space: nowrap;

    padding: 4px 7px;

    background: rgba(8,5,2,0.90);
    border: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.5);

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

@keyframes mapKonarkPulse {
    0% {
        transform: scale(0.95);
        box-shadow:
            0 0 0 4px rgba(246,216,120,0.16),
            0 0 13px rgba(246,216,120,0.55);
    }

    50% {
        transform: scale(1.08);
        box-shadow:
            0 0 0 8px rgba(246,216,120,0.06),
            0 0 22px rgba(246,216,120,0.80);
    }

    100% {
        transform: scale(0.95);
        box-shadow:
            0 0 0 4px rgba(246,216,120,0.16),
            0 0 13px rgba(246,216,120,0.55);
    }
}

.map-footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;

    margin-top: 8px;
    padding: 7px 3px 0;

    border-top: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.22);

    color: #b9a98d;
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.map-footer strong {
    color: var(--light-gold);
}

.modal-close {
    margin-top: 20px;

    padding: 9px 24px;

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    background: transparent;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-family: Georgia, serif;

    cursor: pointer;
}

/* =========================
   COMPLETION
========================= */

.completion {
    position: fixed;

    inset: 0;

    z-index: 250;

    display: none;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    padding: 25px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            rgba(5,3,2,0.82),
            rgba(5,3,2,0.92)
        ),
        url("assets/konark.jpeg") center / cover no-repeat;
}

.completion.show {
    display: flex;
}

.completion-box {
    width: min(550px, 94%);

    padding: 35px;

    text-align: center;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(42,25,10,0.97),
            rgba(8,5,2,0.98)
        );

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    box-shadow:
        0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
}

.completion-small {
    color: var(--gold);

    font-size: 12px;

    letter-spacing: 3px;

    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.completion-title {
    margin-top: 8px;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 30px;

    font-weight: normal;
}

.completion-score {
    margin: 22px 0;

    font-size: 50px;
}

.completion-stats {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr);

    margin-bottom: 25px;

    border-top: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.35);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.35);
}

.completion-stat {
    padding: 13px 5px;
}

.completion-stat + .completion-stat {
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.35);
}

.completion-stat-label {
    display: block;

    color: #cbbda5;

    font-size: 10px;

    letter-spacing: 1px;

    text-transform: uppercase;

    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.completion-stat-value {
    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-size: 21px;
}

.play-again {
    padding: 11px 30px;

    border: 1px solid var(--gold);

    background: transparent;

    color: var(--light-gold);

    font-family: Georgia, serif;

    cursor: pointer;
}

/* =========================
   RESPONSIVE
========================= */

@media (max-width: 1150px) {

    .content {
        grid-template-columns:
            220px
            minmax(550px,1fr)
            175px;

        gap: 14px;

        padding: 18px;
    }

    .main-heading {
        font-size: 29px;
    }

    .description {
        font-size: 14px;
    }

    .topbar {
        padding: 0 18px;
    }

    .brand {
        font-size: 20px;
    }

    .mode-title {
        min-width: 290px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {

    body {
        overflow: auto;
    }

    .game {
        height: auto;
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .topbar {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .mode-title,
    .top-actions {
        display: none;
    }

    .content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        padding: 20px 15px 30px;
    }

    .left-panel,
    .right-panel {
        display: none;
    }

    .center-panel {
        min-height: auto;
    }

    .cards {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr);

        grid-template-rows:
            repeat(3,170px);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {

    .cards {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;

        grid-template-rows:
            repeat(6,170px);
    }

    .completion-stats {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .completion-stat + .completion-stat {
        border-left: none;

        border-top: 1px solid rgba(231,185,79,0.35);
    }
}
</style>
</head>

<body>

<div class="game">

<header class="topbar">

    <div class="brand">
        <div class="brand-symbol">☼</div>
        <span>Heritage Quest</span>
    </div>

    <div class="mode-title">
        <small>Mode 1 of 5</small>
        <strong>The Sound Identifier</strong>
    </div>

    <div class="top-actions">

        <span
            class="top-action"
            data-modal="journal"
            role="button"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            Journal
        </span>

        <span
            class="top-action"
            data-modal="map"
            role="button"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            Map
        </span>

        <span
            class="top-action"
            data-modal="inventory"
            role="button"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            Inventory
        </span>

    </div>

</header>


<main class="content">

<!-- LEFT -->

<aside class="left-panel">

    <div>

        <div class="mode-label">
            MODE 1
        </div>

        <h1 class="main-heading">
            THE SOUND<br>
            IDENTIFIER
        </h1>

    </div>


    <p class="description">
        Listen carefully to the sounds.
        Identify the correct sound that belongs to
        <span>Konark Sun Temple</span>.
    </p>


    <div class="instruction-box">

        <div class="instruction-title">
            INSTRUCTIONS
        </div>

        <div class="instruction">
            <span class="instruction-number">1</span>
            <span>Listen to the sound.</span>
        </div>

        <div class="instruction">
            <span class="instruction-number">2</span>
            <span>Think and identify.</span>
        </div>

        <div class="instruction">
            <span class="instruction-number">3</span>
            <span>Select the correct answer.</span>
        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="facts-box">

        <div class="facts-title">
            KONARK • INTERESTING FACTS
        </div>

        <div class="fact">
            The temple is designed as a gigantic stone chariot associated with Surya, the Sun God.
        </div>

        <div class="fact">
            Its famous wheel carvings are richly detailed enough to reveal motifs, figures and patterns rather than functioning as simple decoration.
        </div>

        <div class="fact">
            The monument's architecture combines sculpture, astronomy-related symbolism and the visual idea of a moving celestial chariot.
        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="score-box">

        <div class="score-item">

            <span class="score-label">
                Score
            </span>

            <span
                class="score-value"
                id="score"
            >
                0
            </span>

        </div>

        <div class="score-item">

            <span class="score-label">
                Streak
            </span>

            <span
                class="score-value"
                id="streak"
            >
                0
            </span>

        </div>

    </div>

</aside>


<!-- CENTER -->

<section class="center-panel">

    <div class="question-header">

        Question
        <strong id="questionHeader">
            1 / 5
        </strong>

    </div>


    <div class="sound-panel">

        <div class="sound-title">
            Listen to the sound
        </div>

        <button
            id="soundButton"
            class="sound-button"
            type="button"
        >
            ▶
        </button>

        <div
            id="soundStatus"
            class="sound-status"
        >
            PLAY SOUND
        </div>

        <div class="sound-question">
            What is this sound?
        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="answers-title">
        Select one answer
    </div>


    <!-- EXACTLY FIVE CARDS -->

    <div
        class="cards"
        id="cards"
    >

        <div
            class="card"
            data-answer="bell"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            <img
                class="card-image"
                src="assets/temple bell.jpeg"
                alt="Temple Bell"
            >

            <div class="card-name">
                TEMPLE BELL
            </div>
        </div>


        <div
            class="card"
            data-answer="flute"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            <img
                class="card-image"
                src="assets/flute.jpeg"
                alt="Flute"
            >

            <div class="card-name">
                FLUTE
            </div>
        </div>


        <div
            class="card"
            data-answer="mardala"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            <img
                class="card-image"
                src="assets/mardala.jpeg"
                alt="Mardala"
            >

            <div class="card-name">
                MARDALA
            </div>
        </div>
<div
            class="card"
            data-answer="odissi"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            <img
                class="card-image"
                src="assets/odishi.jpeg"
                alt="Odissi"
            >

            <div class="card-name">
                ODISSI
            </div>
        </div>


        <div
            class="card"
            data-answer="shankha"
            tabindex="0"
        >
            <img
                class="card-image"
                src="assets/sankha.jpeg"
                alt="Shankha"
            >

            <div class="card-name">
                SHANKHA
            </div>
        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="submit-row">

        <button
            id="submitButton"
            class="submit-button"
            type="button"
            disabled
        >
            Submit Answer
        </button>

    </div>

</section>


<!-- RIGHT -->

<aside class="right-panel">

    <div class="progress-box">

        <div class="progress-label">
            Level Progress
        </div>

        <div
            class="progress-percent"
            id="progressPercent"
        >
            0%
        </div>

        <div class="progress-track">

            <div
                id="progressFill"
                class="progress-fill"
            ></div>

        </div>

        <div class="progress-divider"></div>

        <div class="question-number-label">
            Question
        </div>

        <div
            id="questionNumber"
            class="question-number"
        >
            1 / 5
        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="tip-box">

        <strong>
            INTERESTING FACT
        </strong>

        Konark's stone wheels are often described as giant wheels of the Sun Temple's chariot, and their carved details make them one of the monument's most recognizable features.

        <br><br>

        <strong>LISTENING TIP</strong>
<br><br>

        Click the sound button again whenever you want to stop the audio.

    </div>

</aside>

</main>

</div>


<!-- FEEDBACK -->

<div
    id="feedback"
    class="feedback"
></div>


<!-- INFORMATION MODAL -->

<div
    id="infoModal"
    class="modal"
>

    <div class="modal-box">

        <h2
            id="modalTitle"
            class="modal-title"
        >
        </h2>

        <div
            id="modalText"
            class="modal-text"
        >
        </div>

        <div
            id="mapVisual"
            class="map-visual"
            aria-label="Odisha tourist map showing Konark"
        >

            <div class="map-heading">

                <strong>
                    ODISHA • KONARK
                </strong>

                <span>
                    HERITAGE MAP
                </span>

            </div>


            <div class="map-frame">

                <img
                    src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"
                    alt="Odisha tourist map showing districts and Konark"
                >
<div class="map-caption">
                    KONARK SUN TEMPLE • PURI DISTRICT
                </div>

            </div>


            <div class="map-footer">

                <span>
                    <strong>QUEST:</strong>
                    Konark Sun Temple
                </span>

                <span>
                    <strong>REGION:</strong>
                    Odisha • Eastern Coast
                </span>

            </div>

        </div>

        <button
            id="modalClose"
            class="modal-close"
            type="button"
        >
            CLOSE
        </button>

    </div>

</div>


<!-- COMPLETION -->

<div
    id="completion"
    class="completion"
>

    <div class="completion-box">

        <div class="completion-small">
            Heritage Quest Complete
        </div>

        <h2 class="completion-title">
            The Sound Identifier
        </h2>

        <div
            id="finalScore"
            class="completion-score"
        >
            0 / 50
        </div>

        <div class="completion-stats">

            <div class="completion-stat">

                <span class="completion-stat-label">
                    Correct Answers
                </span>

                <span
                    id="finalCorrect"
                    class="completion-stat-value"
                >
                    0 / 5
                </span>

            </div>

            <div class="completion-stat">

                <span class="completion-stat-label">
                    Best Streak
                </span>

                <span
                    id="finalBestStreak"
                    class="completion-stat-value"
                >
                    0
                </span>

            </div>

            <div class="completion-stat">

                <span class="completion-stat-label">
                    Accuracy
                </span>

                <span
                    id="finalAccuracy"
                    class="completion-stat-value"
                >
                    0%
                </span>

            </div>

        </div>

        <button
            id="playAgain"
            class="play-again"
            type="button"
        >
            PLAY AGAIN
        </button>

    </div>

</div>


<audio id="gameAudio" preload="auto"></audio>

<script>

/* =========================================================
   EXACT AUDIO ↔ ANSWER MAPPING
========================================================= */

const GAME_ITEMS = {

    bell: {
        name: "TEMPLE BELL",
        audio: "assets/audio/Bell.mp3"
    },

    flute: {
        name: "FLUTE",
        audio: "assets/audio/Flute.mp3"
    },

    mardala: {
        name: "MARDALA",
        audio: "assets/audio/Odishi.mp3"
    },
odissi: {
        name: "ODISSI",
        audio: "assets/audio/Mardala.mp3"
    },

    shankha: {
        name: "SHANKHA",
        audio: "assets/audio/Sankha.mp3"
    }

};


/* =========================================================
   IMPORTANT:
   QUESTIONS CONTAIN THE ACTUAL ANSWER ID.
   AUDIO IS NEVER MATCHED BY CARD POSITION.
========================================================= */

let questions = [
    "bell",
    "flute",
    "mardala",
    "odissi",
    "shankha"
];


/* =========================================================
   STATE
========================================================= */

let currentQuestion = 0;
let score = 0;
let streak = 0;
let bestStreak = 0;
let correctAnswers = 0;

let selectedAnswer = null;
let locked = false;


/* =========================================================
   AUDIO
========================================================= */

const audio = document.getElementById("gameAudio");

audio.preload = "auto";
audio.loop = false;
audio.volume = 1.0;

let audioPlaying = false;



/* =========================================================
   ELEMENTS
========================================================= */

const soundButton =
    document.getElementById("soundButton");

const soundStatus =
    document.getElementById("soundStatus");

const submitButton =
    document.getElementById("submitButton");

const cardElements =
    document.querySelectorAll(".card");

const scoreElement =
    document.getElementById("score");

const streakElement =
    document.getElementById("streak");

const questionHeader =
    document.getElementById("questionHeader");

const questionNumber =
    document.getElementById("questionNumber");

const progressPercent =
    document.getElementById("progressPercent");

const progressFill =
    document.getElementById("progressFill");

const feedback =
    document.getElementById("feedback");


/* =========================================================
   SHUFFLE
========================================================= */

function shuffle(array) {

    const copy = [...array];

    for (
        let i = copy.length - 1;
        i > 0;
        i--
    ) {

        const j =
            Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

        [
            copy[i],
            copy[j]
        ] = [
            copy[j],
            copy[i]
        ];
    }

    return copy;
}


/* =========================================================
   STOP AUDIO
========================================================= */

function stopAudio() {

    audio.pause();

    audio.currentTime = 0;

    audioPlaying = false;

    soundButton.classList.remove(
        "playing"
    );

    soundButton.textContent = "▶";

    soundStatus.textContent =
        "PLAY SOUND";
}


/* =========================================================
   LOAD QUESTION
========================================================= */

function loadQuestion() {

    locked = false;

    selectedAnswer = null;

    stopAudio();

    cardElements.forEach(card => {

        card.classList.remove(
            "selected",
            "correct",
            "wrong"
        );

    });

    submitButton.disabled = true;


    /*
     * THIS IS THE IMPORTANT FIX.
     *
     * We get the answer ID directly.
     * Then we get its matching audio directly.
     *
     * Example:
     * "mardala"
     *      ↓
     * GAME_ITEMS.mardala
     *      ↓
     * assets/audio/Mardala.mp3
     */

    const answerId =
        questions[currentQuestion];

    const questionData =
        GAME_ITEMS[answerId];


    /*
     * Safety check.
     */

    if (!questionData) {

        console.error(
            "Invalid question:",
            answerId
        );

        return;
    }


    /*
     * Load EXACT matching audio.
     */

    audio.src =
        questionData.audio;

    audio.load();



    updateUI();
}


/* =========================================================
   UPDATE UI
========================================================= */

function updateUI() {

    const number =
        currentQuestion + 1;

    questionHeader.textContent =
        `${number} / 5`;

    questionNumber.textContent =
        `${number} / 5`;


    /*
     * Progress is based on completed questions.
     */

    const progress =
        Math.round(
            (currentQuestion / 5) * 100
        );

    progressPercent.textContent =
        `${progress}%`;

    progressFill.style.width =
        `${progress}%`;


    scoreElement.textContent =
        score;

    streakElement.textContent =
        streak;
}


/* =========================================================
   PLAY / STOP
========================================================= */

soundButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    async function() {

        if (locked) {
            return;
        }


        /*
         * SECOND CLICK = STOP
         */

        if (audioPlaying) {

            stopAudio();

            return;
        }


        try {


            await audio.play();

            audioPlaying = true;

            soundButton.classList.add(
                "playing"
            );

            soundButton.textContent =
                "■";

            soundStatus.textContent =
                "STOP SOUND";

        } catch (error) {

            console.error(
                "Audio playback error:",
                error
            );

            showFeedback(
                "Could not play this sound. Check the audio file.",
                "error"
            );
        }

    }
);


/* =========================================================
   AUDIO FINISHED
========================================================= */

audio.addEventListener(
    "ended",
    function() {

        audioPlaying = false;

        soundButton.classList.remove(
            "playing"
        );

        soundButton.textContent =
            "▶";

        soundStatus.textContent =
            "PLAY SOUND";

    }
);


/* =========================================================
   SELECT CARD
========================================================= */

cardElements.forEach(card => {

    function selectCard() {

        if (locked) {
            return;
        }


        cardElements.forEach(other => {

            other.classList.remove(
                "selected"
            );

        });


        card.classList.add(
            "selected"
        );


        selectedAnswer =
            card.dataset.answer;


        submitButton.disabled =
            false;

    }


    card.addEventListener(
        "click",
        selectCard
    );


    card.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        function(event) {

            if (
                event.key === "Enter" ||
                event.key === " "
            ) {

                event.preventDefault();

                selectCard();

            }

        }
    );

});


/* =========================================================
   SUBMIT ANSWER
========================================================= */

submitButton.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function() {

        if (
            !selectedAnswer ||
            locked
        ) {
            return;
        }


        /*
         * Stop sound immediately.
         */

        stopAudio();


        /*
         * EXACT correct answer ID.
         */

        const correctAnswer =
            questions[currentQuestion];


        /* =========================
           CORRECT
        ========================= */

        if (
            selectedAnswer ===
            correctAnswer
        ) {

            locked = true;

            score += 10;

            streak++;

            correctAnswers++;


            if (
                streak > bestStreak
            ) {

                bestStreak =
                    streak;

            }


            const selectedCard =
                document.querySelector(
                    `.card[data-answer="${selectedAnswer}"]`
                );


            selectedCard.classList.remove(
                "selected"
            );

            selectedCard.classList.add(
                "correct"
            );


            scoreElement.textContent =
                score;

            streakElement.textContent =
                streak;


            submitButton.disabled =
                true;


            showFeedback(
                "✓ Correct! +10 points",
                "success"
            );


            setTimeout(
                function() {

                    currentQuestion++;


                    if (
                        currentQuestion >= 5
                    ) {

                        finishGame();

                    } else {

                        loadQuestion();

                    }

                },
                1100
            );

        }


        /* =========================
           WRONG
        ========================= */

        else {

            streak = 0;

            streakElement.textContent =
                streak;


            const selectedCard =
                document.querySelector(
                    `.card[data-answer="${selectedAnswer}"]`
                );


            selectedCard.classList.add(
                "wrong"
            );


            showFeedback(
                "✕ Incorrect — try again.",
                "error"
            );


            setTimeout(
                function() {

                    selectedCard.classList.remove(
                        "wrong",
                        "selected"
                    );

                    selectedAnswer =
                        null;

                    submitButton.disabled =
                        true;

                },
                650
            );

        }

    }
);


/* =========================================================
   FEEDBACK
========================================================= */

let feedbackTimeout;

function showFeedback(
    message,
    type
) {

    clearTimeout(
        feedbackTimeout
    );

    feedback.textContent =
        message;

    feedback.className =
        `feedback show ${type}`;


    feedbackTimeout =
        setTimeout(
            function() {

                feedback.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

            },
            1000
        );
}


/* =========================================================
   COMPLETE GAME
========================================================= */

function finishGame() {

    stopAudio();

    progressPercent.textContent =
        "100%";

    progressFill.style.width =
        "100%";


    document.getElementById(
        "finalScore"
    ).textContent =
        `${score} / 50`;


    document.getElementById(
        "finalCorrect"
    ).textContent =
        `${correctAnswers} / 5`;


    document.getElementById(
        "finalBestStreak"
    ).textContent =
        bestStreak;


    document.getElementById(
        "finalAccuracy"
    ).textContent =
        `${Math.round(
            (correctAnswers / 5) * 100
        )}%`;


    document.getElementById(
        "completion"
    ).classList.add("show");
}


/* =========================================================
   PLAY AGAIN
========================================================= */

document.getElementById(
    "playAgain"
).addEventListener(
    "click",
    function() {

        score = 0;

        streak = 0;

        bestStreak = 0;

        correctAnswers = 0;

        currentQuestion = 0;

        selectedAnswer = null;

        locked = false;


        questions =
            shuffle([
                "bell",
                "flute",
                "mardala",
                "odissi",
                "shankha"
            ]);


        document.getElementById(
            "completion"
        ).classList.remove("show");


        scoreElement.textContent =
            "0";

        streakElement.textContent =
            "0";

        progressPercent.textContent =
            "0%";

        progressFill.style.width =
            "0%";


        loadQuestion();

    }
);


/* =========================================================
   JOURNAL / MAP / INVENTORY
========================================================= */

const modal =
    document.getElementById(
        "infoModal"
    );

const modalTitle =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalTitle"
    );

const modalText =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalText"
    );

const modalClose =
    document.getElementById(
        "modalClose"
    );

const mapVisual =
    document.getElementById(
        "mapVisual"
    );


const modalContent = {

    journal: {

        title: "JOURNAL",

        text: `
            <p><strong>Echoes of Bharat — Mode 1</strong></p>

            <p>You are exploring the soundscape of Konark through five cultural elements. Listen carefully and identify each sound.</p>

            <p>Every correct identification earns <strong>10 points</strong>.</p>

            <p><strong>Your quest:</strong> Match each sound to the cultural element it represents.</p>

            <p><strong>Current location:</strong> Konark Sun Temple, Odisha.</p>

            <p><strong>Five elements discovered:</strong> Temple Bell, Flute, Mardala, Odissi and Shankha.</p>

            <p>Listen to the sound first, then use the images and names as clues before selecting your answer.</p>

            <p>Your score, streak and level progress update as you complete the five questions.</p>

            <p><strong>Quest note:</strong> Every sound is linked to one of the five cultural elements in this Mode 1 challenge.</p>

            <p><strong>Heritage clue:</strong> Listen for differences in pitch, rhythm, resonance and texture rather than relying only on the picture.</p>

            <p><strong>Field note:</strong> The aim of this mode is to connect a place with the sounds, arts and cultural ideas that help give it character.</p>
        `

    },

    map: {

        title: "MAP",

        text: `
            <p><strong>KONARK SUN TEMPLE</strong></p>

            <p><strong>Location:</strong> Konark, Odisha, India.</p>

            <p>The Sun Temple stands on the eastern coast of India near the Bay of Bengal.</p>

            <p><strong>Current quest location:</strong> Konark — Mode 1.</p>

            <p><strong>Region:</strong> Odisha, eastern India.</p>

            <p><strong>Heritage focus:</strong> Sound, art, culture and architecture connected with the Konark experience.</p>

            <p><strong>Quest route:</strong> Begin at the Konark location and complete all five Sound Identifier questions.</p>

            <p><strong>Destination record:</strong> Konark Sun Temple, Odisha.</p>

            <p>Return to the map whenever you want to see your current quest location.</p>
        `

    },

    inventory: {

        title: "INVENTORY",

        text: `
            <p><strong>HERITAGE ELEMENTS</strong></p>

            <p>Your Mode 1 collection contains exactly five elements:</p>

            <p>• <strong>Temple Bell</strong> — one of the sound clues.</p>
            <p>• <strong>Flute</strong> — a wind-instrument sound in the challenge.</p>
            <p>• <strong>Mardala</strong> — a percussion element in the quest.</p>
            <p>• <strong>Odissi</strong> — Odisha's classical dance tradition represented in the challenge.</p>
            <p>• <strong>Shankha</strong> — the conch sound clue.</p>

            <p><strong>Collection:</strong> 5 heritage elements available in Mode 1.</p>

            <p><strong>Scoring:</strong> Each correct identification earns 10 points.</p>

            <p><strong>Objective:</strong> Identify all five sounds and complete the Sound Identifier quest.</p>
        `

    }

};


/* =========================================================
   OPEN MODALS
========================================================= */

document.querySelectorAll(
    ".top-action"
).forEach(button => {

    function openModal() {

        const type =
            button.dataset.modal;

        const data =
            modalContent[type];

        if (!data) {
            return;
        }

        modalTitle.textContent =
            data.title;

        modalText.innerHTML =
            data.text;

        if (type === "map") {
            mapVisual.classList.add("show");
        } else {
            mapVisual.classList.remove("show");
        }

        modal.classList.add(
            "show"
        );
    }

    button.addEventListener(
        "click",
        openModal
    );

    button.addEventListener(
        "keydown",
        function(event) {

            if (
                event.key === "Enter" ||
                event.key === " "
            ) {

                event.preventDefault();
                openModal();
            }
        }
    );

});

/* =========================================================
   CLOSE MODAL
========================================================= */

modalClose.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function() {

        modal.classList.remove(
            "show"
        );

        mapVisual.classList.remove("show");

    }
);


modal.addEventListener(
    "click",
    function(event) {

        if (
            event.target === modal
        ) {

            modal.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );

            mapVisual.classList.remove("show");

        }

    }
);

document.addEventListener(
    "keydown",
    function(event) {

        if (
            event.key === "Escape" &&
            modal.classList.contains("show")
        ) {

            modal.classList.remove("show");
            mapVisual.classList.remove("show");
        }
    }
);


/* =========================================================
   START
========================================================= */

questions =
    shuffle([
        "bell",
        "flute",
        "mardala",
        "odissi",
        "shankha"
    ]);

loadQuestion();

</script>
